sources.title: llmsforall/Millie-35B-A3B-11GB · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Millie is a 35B-parameter mixture-of-experts coding and agentic model (3B active per token, 262K context, image input) compressed to run on ordinary hardware. It is derived from Agents-A1, built on the Qwen3.5-35B-A3B architecture; expert weights are stored at ~2.2 bits per weight.
